The Board approved the audited standalone results and recommended a final dividend of ₹0.70 per share. KKC & Associates LLP issued a qualified opinion citing an ongoing SFIO investigation against the holding company. The company also noted a material uncertainty regarding going concern due to the absence of fee income but confirmed liquid assets are sufficient.
